subject: Catalog onramp & purchase routes — quick recap and next steps (Helix Health)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Catalog onramp & purchase routes — quick recap and next steps (Helix Health)

Alex — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap while it's fresh and a proposed set of next steps so procurement can move quickly.

Highlights from our conversation:
- Preferred cloud: AWS (mentioned AWS GovCloud for some workloads).
- Buying intent: leaning toward Marketplace (private offer) but procurement evaluating PO/invoice flow and internal card policy.
- Timeline: procurement wants paperflow and billing path confirmed before end of next quarter.

Key questions for procurement we flagged on the call (please confirm):
1) Does Helix require a PO + signed contract before any billing can start, or will a Marketplace private offer with AWS invoice work?
2) If PO required, any specific PO number format or routing address we should include?
3) Are there tax or W-9/invoice fields procurement insists on (billing contact, remit-to)?
4) Do you prefer we set up a Private Offer via AWS Marketplace (Redwood handles the offer), or do you want to purchase via card / centralized corporate card?

Attachments I can share now: Redwood one-pager on AWS Marketplace private offers and a sample PO template (attached).

Proposed next steps:
- You share procurement contact (email + preferred process).
- If private offer: we draft PO-friendly terms and create the AWS private offer; we loop legal if required.
- If PO path: procurement sends sample PO or the PO template filled and we confirm billing details.

Can you confirm procurement contact and preferred path? Happy to set up a short 20-min runbook with procurement to walk the paperflow and timelines.

Thanks —
Karthik
Sr. Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_aws-marketplace-info.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: redwood_po_guidance.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@helixhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procure@helixhealth.com
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Catalog onramp & purchase routes — quick recap and next steps (Helix Health)

Thanks Karthik — good recap. I'm copying our procurement alias so they see the context. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement contact: procure@helixhealth.com (manned by our procurement ops team; primary is Dana Pierce).
- Preferred path: Procurement prefers AWS Marketplace private offers when possible (keeps billing centralized and integrates with our internal vendor catalog). That said, finance still accepts direct PO in special cases.
- PO details: If we go PO, we need remit-to, Redwood's Tax ID, and a billing contact on the invoice. PO number format: HLX-PO-YYYY-####.
- Tax/W-9: We'll need your W-9 and Redwood's vendor setup completed before we can process a PO.

Attaching the PO template procurement uses and a quick checklist on what they need from vendors.

Proposed next step: Dana from procurement will reach out with any vendor onboarding portal links and confirm whether a Private Offer is acceptable for this purchase size. If you can draft the AWS Private Offer terms that match our expected consumption band, that will speed approval.

Best,
Alex Gomez
Senior Product Manager, Data Platforms
Helix Health
[Attachment: helix_po_template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: procure@helixhealth.com, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Catalog onramp & purchase routes — quick recap and next steps (Helix Health)

Hi Dana / procurement team — thanks for joining the thread. Per Alex, sounds like AWS Private Offer is the preferred route, which aligns with how many customers keep billing and procurement tidy. To make this concrete, here are the artifacts we can provide this week to help you evaluate: 

- Draft private offer terms (unit pricing bands and start date options).
- Redwood vendor packet: W-9, tax ID (EIN: 12-3456789), standard vendor contact (billing@redwood.com).
- Sample invoice layout that matches Helix PO fields.

If procurement prefers direct PO instead, we can accept HLX-PO- formatted POs but will need vendor onboarding completed. Steps for either path: 
1) You confirm: Private Offer OK? If yes, we will generate the Private Offer in AWS and share the DocuSign link for final acceptance.
2) If PO required: send sample PO back filled with expected start date and PO number so we can confirm the invoice remit fields.
3) Tell us if you need a SOW or custom terms attached to the PO (usually not for platform usage).

Proposed scheduling: 20-minute sync this Thurs 10–10:30am PT to walk the Private Offer flow and confirm which doc to sign. If that works for you, I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Karthik
Sr. Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_vendor_packet.zip (stubs: W-9, EIN letter)]

From: procure@helixhealth.com <procure@helixhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Catalog onramp & purchase routes — quick recap and next steps (Helix Health)

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear options. Dana here (procurement ops). Private Offer is preferable for this contract size; please proceed to create the AWS Private Offer and set the start date window to 01/03/2028 - 01/15/2028. We will need: 

- Private Offer draft + consumption bands for approval.
- Redwood W-9 and vendor contact for vendor setup (we received your vendor packet).
- DocuSign for signature on our side (we will countersign via DocuSign).

We can take a quick 20-min runbook Thursday at 10:00 AM PT to confirm the flow. Alex will join; Marissa I see is on the thread as Redwood contact.

Action items we will take this week:
- Open vendor onboarding ticket and confirm if any additional tax fields are required.
- Validate whether our finance team needs a separate PO after Private Offer activation (they may still request an internal PO for reconciliation).

Dana Pierce
Procurement Operations
Helix Health
procure@helixhealth.com
